item.title: System76 on Age Verification Laws
item.description:

item.title: TeX Live 2026 is available for download now
item.description:
📝 Mirroring/downloading the TeX Live repository (typically because you have problems with network installation, or have several machines to keep updated). edu/pub/tex/historic/systems/texlive/2022/tlnet-final tlmgr update. Any updates will then also have to be made through your distro.
🔗 Read more: https://www.tug.org/texlive/acquire.html
